component.name: milvus
component.title: Milvus
component.description: Create collections and indexes, and insert, upsert, delete, search and query entities in the Milvus vector database.
component.label: database,ai

action.description: The action to perform. The CamelMilvusAction header, when set, wins over this option.

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints start from. Each endpoint gets a copy, and its options replace the values of the copy. It also holds the MilvusClient that MilvusConfiguration.setClient() sets, which the endpoints share.

host.description: The host name or IP address of the Milvus server. Not used when a MilvusClient is set with MilvusConfiguration.setClient().

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

port.description: The gRPC port of the Milvus server. Not used when a MilvusClient is set with MilvusConfiguration.setClient().

timeout.description: The timeout in milliseconds for connecting to the Milvus server, 10000 if not set. The value must be greater than 0. It is not a timeout of each request: the requests have no deadline. Not used when a MilvusClient is set with MilvusConfiguration.setClient().

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

caPemPath.label: security
caPemPath.description: The path of a PEM file with the certificate authority that the client trusts for mutual TLS. Set it together with clientPemPath and clientKeyPath; for one-way TLS use serverPemPath instead. Not used when a MilvusClient is set with MilvusConfiguration.setClient().

clientKeyPath.label: security
clientKeyPath.description: The path of a PEM file with the private key (PKCS#8) of the client for mutual TLS. Set it together with caPemPath and clientPemPath. Not used when a MilvusClient is set with MilvusConfiguration.setClient().

clientPemPath.label: security
clientPemPath.description: The path of a PEM file with the certificate of the client for mutual TLS. Set it together with caPemPath and clientKeyPath. Not used when a MilvusClient is set with MilvusConfiguration.setClient().

secure.label: security
secure.description: Whether to connect to the Milvus server with TLS. If not set, the connection is plaintext, and the token is sent in clear text, unless serverPemPath, or caPemPath with clientPemPath and clientKeyPath, is set. Without these options, the client trusts the certificate authorities of the JVM. Not used when a MilvusClient is set with MilvusConfiguration.setClient().

serverName.label: security
serverName.description: The name that the client expects in the certificate of the Milvus server (the authority of the gRPC channel), when it differs from the host. Only used with serverPemPath, where the host is used if not set, or with mutual TLS. Not used when a MilvusClient is set with MilvusConfiguration.setClient().

serverPemPath.label: security
serverPemPath.description: The path of a PEM file with the certificate of the Milvus server, or of the certificate authority that signed it, that the client trusts for one-way TLS. Setting it connects with TLS. Not used when a MilvusClient is set with MilvusConfiguration.setClient().

token.label: security
token.description: The token that the client sends to authenticate with Milvus: a user name and password joined by a colon, or an API key of Zilliz Cloud. If not set, the client sends no credentials. Not used when a MilvusClient is set with MilvusConfiguration.setClient().

CamelMilvusAction.description: The action that the producer performs. It wins over the action option. The milvus:embeddings transformer reads it too, and accepts only INSERT and UPSERT.

CamelMilvusOperationStatus.description: The status code of the response of Milvus. The producer sets it only after an action that succeeded, so it is always 0. When Milvus returns another code, the producer fails the exchange.

CamelMilvusOperationStatusValue.description: The status code of the response of Milvus as an int, the same value as the CamelMilvusOperationStatus header.

CamelMilvusTextFieldName.description: The name of the field for the text of the TextSegment, in the InsertParam or UpsertParam that the milvus:embeddings transformer builds. The default is text.

CamelMilvusVectorFieldName.description: The name of the field for the embedding vector, in the InsertParam or UpsertParam that the milvus:embeddings transformer builds. The default is vector.

CamelMilvusCollectionName.description: The name of the collection, in the InsertParam or UpsertParam that the milvus:embeddings transformer builds. The default is embeddings: the transformer does not use the collection of the endpoint.

CamelMilvusKeyName.description: The name of the primary key field, in the InsertParam or UpsertParam that the milvus:embeddings transformer builds. The default is id. The transformer adds the key field only when the CamelMilvusKeyValue header is set.

CamelMilvusKeyValue.description: The value of the primary key, in the InsertParam or UpsertParam that the milvus:embeddings transformer builds. If not set, the transformer adds no key field, as for a collection whose primary key has autoID enabled.

producerIn.description: The request of the Milvus SDK for the action in the action option or the CamelMilvusAction header: a CreateCollectionParam, CreateIndexParam, InsertParam, UpsertParam, SearchSimpleParam, QueryParam or DeleteParam. Another body fails, a vector as a List too: the milvus:embeddings data type transformer builds the InsertParam or UpsertParam from the output of langchain4j-embeddings

producerOut.description: The result of the Milvus SDK for the action: an RpcStatus for CREATE_COLLECTION and CREATE_INDEX, a MutationResult for INSERT, UPSERT and DELETE, a SearchResponse for SEARCH and a QueryResults for QUERY

collection.description: The name of the collection that the producer loads into memory before SEARCH, QUERY and DELETE. The request in the message body names the collection that the action works on, so it must name the same collection.

action.description: The action to perform. The CamelMilvusAction header, when set, wins over this option.
